title: POL-462: policy for the Payroll Gateway
body:
## Scope

The policy below governs use of the Payroll Gateway; it is
effective. The policy owner is Felix Brandt (Platform
Engineering); yearly audits against the controls listed here
are run by Meridian Cloud.

## Requirements

As of the 19 October 2025 review the requirements are:
- Complete the annual security training before the published
  deadline
- Tag every cloud resource with an owner and a cost centre
- Document every manual change in the shared change log

## Status

The policy is effective according to the register. Issued by
Hannah Cole on 9 October 2025; 33 exceptions are on file
with Platform Engineering and expire at the yearly audit.
